title: Native names
description: What cst branch --json and cst tag --json print in a native repository (CLI output; native/cli/src/native_names.rs, ADR-0047 decisions 9 and 12): the names listed, branches, tags and remote-tracking names (docs/native-history/operations.md §2), in order of kind, then of name in byte order. Every name a listing shows is listed, a symbolic one whose target names nothing included. A name's bytes need not be UTF-8: name holds them decoded with replacement, and nameHex holds them, in lowercase hex, exactly when they are not UTF-8.

kind.description: A name's kind (operations.md §2.1): a branch comes from refs/heads/, a tag from refs/tags/ and a remote-tracking name, read-only until N5 defines remotes, from refs/remotes/.

name.description: The name, without its kind's namespace, such as main or origin/main.

nameHex.description: The name as stored, present only when it is not UTF-8.

local.description: Whether a branch is local, which N5 never sends unless asked; false for every other kind.

target.description: What a name names: an object, by object and type, or another name, by kind and name, which makes the name symbolic; a target holds exactly one of the two pairs. A symbolic name's target need not exist.

object.description: The object, by the ID a command names it by: a native commit or a native tag where import derived one.

nameHex.description: The target name as stored, present only when it is not UTF-8.
